title: Reinstatement of Redeemed Roamhaven Rewards Credits
content:
## Clause

When a stay paid partly with Roamhaven Rewards credits is refunded, the redeemed credits come back in the proportion that the refunded amount bears to the stay's total price, rounded to the nearest cent, half up. Reinstated credits expire on the later of the original balance's expiry and the date that falls the tier's minimum validity, in calendar days, after the reinstatement. Nothing is reinstated while the membership is suspended or after it is closed. A refund reinstates once per redemption and refund date.

## The amount, defined

The credits reinstated are the credits redeemed on the stay, multiplied by the refunded amount and divided by the stay's total price, then rounded to the nearest cent, half up. The member's statement shows each reinstatement against the refunded stay and the redemption it reinstates, with the date the reinstated credits expire.

| Hypothetical stay | Total price (USD) | Credits redeemed | Amount refunded (USD) | Share refunded | Credits reinstated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1600.00 | 200.00 | 400.00 | one quarter | 50.00 |
| B | 1450.00 | 135.00 | 600.00 | 600 of 1450 | 55.86 (55.862… rounded half up) |
| C | 900.00 | 90.00 | 900.00 | the whole stay | 90.00 |

## The expiry date, defined

The reinstated credits expire on whichever date is later: the expiry of the original balance, or the reinstatement date moved forward by the tier's minimum validity in calendar days.

Hypothetical cases, taking a minimum validity of 90 calendar days and a reinstatement on 10 March (90 calendar days later is 8 June):

| Original balance's expiry | Reinstated credits expire on |
|---|---|
| 15 April | 8 June (the later date) |
| 1 September | 1 September (the later date) |

## Points of judgement

| Membership on the member's record | Reinstatement |
|---|---|
| Suspended | Nothing reinstated |
| Closed | Nothing reinstated |

| Refund of the stay | Reinstatement against the same redemption |
|---|---|
| A refund date for which that redemption has already been reinstated | Not reinstated again |
| A further refund on a different date | Reinstates once for that refund date |
